message: After the capture operation for Setsugekka utilizing carbohydrate restriction ended.
Summoned by Asahi, I arrived in front of the convenience store with Setsugekka.

name: Iori
message: 「So, how is Ririmu doing？」

name: Asahi
message: 「She just walked into the convenience store.」

name: Asahi
message: 「I believe now is the perfect time to initiate the operation.」

name: Iori
message: 「Good, good, that’s great.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Muragaki-sensei, what are you planning to do now？」

name: Iori
message: 「I’m starting the Ririmu capture operation.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Cap-ture op-er-a-tion？」

name: Iori
message: 「Exactly. It’s a mission of utmost importance to persuade her to attend classes, just like you, Setsugekka.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「In my case, it was more like bribery or maybe blackmail than persuasion.」

name: Asahi
message: 「That was enough in your case, Setsugekka-san.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「What’s that supposed to mean!」

name: Iori
message: 「Well, Setsugekka, you’re the type who just goes with the flow.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「That’s wrong, I think before I act!」

name: Iori
message: 「Calm down, there’s a part for you in this operation too.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Eh, really？ Can I actually be useful？」

name: Iori
message: 「Yeah, of course.」

name: Iori
message: 「Alright, let’s begin Operation ‘Green Grass Belongs to Everyone’！」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Whew, shopping done. Now, what should I do next~」
I stretch as I exit the convenience store and look around.

name: Ririmu
message: 「…Wait, isn’t that Sensei and the demoness？」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Uh-oh, gotta hide！」
Iori and Asahi walk right past me. They don’t seem to have noticed me.

name: Asahi
message: 「I’m counting on you today too, Iori-sensei!」

name: Iori
message: 「Of course. We’re going to be drilling hard.」

name: Asahi
message: 「Yes!」

name: Ririmu
message: （Ah, so the two of them are headed to the outdoor training grounds. How diligent of them~）
Hiding behind the convenience store, I watch them.

name: Iori
message: 「Asahi, you’re a really fast learner. At this rate, becoming a Toujinegi isn’t just a pipe dream.」

name: Asahi
message: 「Hehehe, that’s just because Iori-sensei is such a good teacher♪」

name: Ririmu
message: （Wow~, talk about laying on the flattery.）
They stop to keep talking, perhaps needing something at the convenience store.

name: Asahi
message: 「By the way, Iori-sensei, how good would you say I am right now？」

name: Iori
message: 「Well, let's see. If you were up against Ririmu, I think you'd have an easy win.」

name: Ririmu
message: （Huh！? An easy win? No way in hell...！）
That really pissed me off. There's no way I'd lose to a Kijo.

name: Asahi
message: 「But Ririmu-san is training too, isn't she？」

name: Iori
message: 「That may be, but there's a limit to how far you can get training on your own.」

name: Iori
message: 「As things stand, I doubt she'll even make the selection for the Martial Festival preliminaries.」

name: Ririmu
message: （Hey, you’ve got to be kidding me！？）
I nearly let out a sound and hurriedly covered my mouth.

name: Iori
message: 「Well, regarding Ririmu, there’s an even bigger problem—there’s a chance she might fail out before the Martial Festival even begins.」

name: Ririmu
message: （Ugh... I don't want that~）

name: Asahi
message: 「Hmm, is that so?」

name: Asahi
message: 「Then that means Ririmu-san loses without even having to fight, right?♪」

name: Ririmu
message: （That woman... she's so annoying...！）

name: Iori
message: 「No, don't let your guard down. Ririmu is actually fairly strong.」

name: Iori
message: 「She has a unique rhythm that’s hard to predict; if you challenge her without any preparation, you’ll definitely have a tough time.」

name: Ririmu
message: （Yeah, yeah, that’s right, Iorin.）
The anger melted away thanks to Sensei's defense.

name: Asahi
message: 「In that case, Iori-sensei, please teach me how to counter Ririmu-san.」

name: Iori
message: 「Of course. That's what my coaching is for.」

name: Asahi
message: 「Hehe, at this rate, I'll be the only one getting stronger, won't I?」

name: Ririmu
message: （H-Hey... wait a second, isn't that unfair？！）

name: Iori
message: 「Hey now, I have no intention of playing favorites with anyone.」

name: Iori
message: 「If Ririmu actually comes to the classroom and accepts my coaching, I'll teach her how to counter you.」

name: Iori
message: 「It wouldn't be fair otherwise, right?」

name: Ririmu
message: （Iorin...）
I don't know what it is, but this guy is a little different from the adults I've met so far.
He has solid principles, nothing snide about him, and he doesn't look at me with prejudice.

name: Ririmu
message: （...Yeah, I might actually like this guy.）

name: Asahi
message: 「Aww, you'd really teach Ririmu-san how to counter me？」

name: Iori
message: 「Well, only if Ririmu actually feels like taking my coaching, though.」

name: Asahi
message: 「Then allow me to say a little prayer.」

name: Asahi
message: 「May Ririmu-san remain oblivious to how wonderful Iori-sensei is, cling stubbornly to her own values, and fade into obscurity.」

name: Ririmu
message: （Whaaat did she say...?! This bitch—now I'm really pissed!）
At the end of my patience, just as I'm about to jump out—

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Heeey, heeey! Muragaki-senseeei!」

name: Iori
message: 「Oh, it's you, Setsugekka.」
Seeing Setsugekka approaching from over there, I hurriedly hide.

name: Ririmu
message: （Huh？ That's weird, were Setsugekka and Teach always on good terms？）
The Setsugekka I know was definitely avoiding Teach.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Muragaki-sensei, give me some coaching too~」

name: Iori
message: 「Yeah, of course. You're a precious student of mine too, Setsugekka！」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Hmm, that sounds kinda fake.」

name: Iori
message: 「Hey.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Oh well, if it's for fried rice, I'll do my best！」

name: Ririmu
message: （Fried rice？）

name: Iori
message: 「W-Well, whatever the reason, I'll put everything I've got into training you so you can get stronger, Setsugekka」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Yeah, yeah! Then let's head to the training grounds together!」

name: Asahi
message: 「Hey now, Setsugekka-san, you're being way too familiar with Iori-sensei」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Huh, isn't that mutual？」
Setsugekka and Asahi bantering noisily with Sensei caught between them.
Just like that, the three of them headed off toward the outdoor training grounds.

name: Ririmu
message: 「What the heck, looking like they're having so much fun」
I'd stayed hidden until they passed, yet a strange knot lingered in my chest.
By rights, I should be able to be right there in that circle too.

name: Ririmu
message: 「...Why am I being so stubborn」
If I could just be a little more honest with myself, could I have fun like that too...？

name: Iori
message: 「...Yeah, that should about do it」
After putting Asahi and Setsugekka through some light training.
By the time I finished tidying up the training grounds, the sun had already begun to dip.
Once I got started, I noticed litter and stuff scattered in the grass, so cleaning it all up took longer than expected.

name: Ririmu
message: 「Yo, Iorin」

name: Iori
message: 「Oh, Ririmu. What's up, need something？」
Since I'd sent the other two home earlier, I was the only one left here.

name: Ririmu
message: 「Hmm, not really anything in particular」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Just wondering if you're doing okay~」
Ririmu looking somewhat hesitant to speak.

name: Iori
message: 「Not doing so great since you aren't around, Ririmu」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Idiot, lip service like that doesn't suit you, Sensei」

name: Iori
message: 「Haha, fair enough」

name: Iori
message: 「So, when are you finally going to show up to my classes, Ririmu？」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Well, that's... whenever I feel like it？」
She looked away awkwardly.

name: Iori
message: 「Come to think of it, I owe you an apology, Ririmu」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Wait, why？」

name: Iori
message: 「You asked me a question the other day, Ririmu.」

name: Iori
message: 「You asked why students in the Martial Arts Division are failed for not getting good marks on written exams, even if they get good results in practicals.」

name: Iori
message: 「I couldn't answer that question.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「But that's not your fault, Teacher.」

name: Iori
message: 「No, that's not true.」

name: Iori
message: 「It is a teacher's duty to provide answers to what their students wonder about.」

name: Iori
message: 「If I can't do that, I'm not fit to be a teacher. That's what I believe.」
I let out a small sigh.

name: Iori
message: 「But, I've been thinking about it, and I couldn't find one.」

name: Iori
message: 「There's no way written exams can measure character, and I can't explain why a swordsman would need them either.」

name: Iori
message: 「Academics shouldn't be a contest of endurance or a game of scoring points.」

name: Iori
message: 「True learning only happens when there's an inquisitive desire to know.」

name: Iori
message: 「Studying just to get points on a test might be a corrupt act that degrades the dignity of how learning should be.」

name: Iori
message: 「...But, even if I wanted to say, 'Then let's just scrap the written exams,' I don't have the authority to do that.」

name: Iori
message: 「Even if I say it's wrong for Martial Arts students to fail because they got poor marks on a written test, I can't overturn that.」

name: Iori
message: 「I lack the power to satisfy you, Ririmu.」

name: Iori
message: 「So... I'm sorry.」

name: Iori
message: 「I'm sorry I couldn't live up to your expectations, Ririmu.」
I bowed my head to Ririmu.

name: Ririmu
message: 「Hey, stop it, this isn't something you need to apologize for, Teacher.」

name: Iori
message: 「But because I couldn't convince you, Ririmu, you might end up unable to stay at Murakumo Academy.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Even if that's the case, it's my fault, and it has nothing to do with you.」

name: Iori
message: 「How could it have nothing to do with me?」

name: Iori
message: 「As your assistant homeroom teacher, I’ve been entrusted with your lives.」

name: Iori
message: 「If I can't convince you right here, I know I'll regret it for the rest of my life.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Iorin...」

name: Iori
message: 「Ririmu, I don't want you to quit.」

name: Iori
message: 「You have a rare talent that nobody else possesses. I want to see you grow as a swordswoman.」

name: Iori
message: 「I might not be able to give you an answer that satisfies you... but I know I can make you stronger.」

name: Iori
message: 「But if you fail your exams, even that possibility will be taken away.」

name: Iori
message: 「I'd be sad if you were gone, and it'd really frustrate me.」

name: Iori
message: 「Hey... what should I do？」
I ask her earnestly.

name: Ririmu
message: 「Wh-What the heck... Saying stuff like that isn't fair.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「If you put it like that, I've got no choice but to give in, y'know.」

name: Iori
message: 「Ririmu, will you do this with me？」

name: Ririmu
message: 「...Well, if you're gonna go that far, Teach, I guess I'll give it a shot.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「There's still time until midterms, so if I start now, I'll manage somehow, right？」

name: Iori
message: 「Yeah, of course！」

name: Iori
message: 「I'll help you out as much as I possibly can. I promise.」

name: Iori
message: 「So promise me too, Ririmu.」

name: Iori
message: 「That you won't run away, and that you'll face any hardship together with me.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Yeah, yeah, roger that！」
Oh, yes! I actually managed to convince Ririmu...!!

name: Ririmu
message: 「Besides, aren't you being a bit dramatic? 'Face any hardship,' really?」

name: Ririmu
message: 「It's just a written test—it'll be a total breeze, I'm telling you.」

name: Iori
message: 「Considering how much you've been running away up till now, you can't blame me. Make sure you keep your promise.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「I know, I know.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Once I've made up my mind and decided on something for myself, I'll do it without anyone telling me to」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Because that's my worldview！」
Either way, that's a relief. With this, the Ririmu conquest campaign is—

name: Asahi
message: 「Ah, Setsugekka-san」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Yeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeah！」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Con-quest com-plete！！」
Setsugekka came tumbling out of the bushes, with Asahi trying to stop her.

name: Ririmu
message: 「Huh！？ W-What？ What do you mean, 'conquest'？」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「You, of course, Ririmu-chan」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Me？ Wait, Teach, what's going on！？」

name: Iori
message: 「Setsugekka, you...！」

name: Asahi
message: 「I'm sorry, Iori-sensei. I tried to stop her, but...」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Huh？ Is the mood kinda weird？」

name: Asahi
message: 「Setsugekka-san, what were you thinking！」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Well, you know, I figured when something like this goes well, running up holding a 'Prank Success！' sign is the classic pat-tern」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Huh？ Wait, was this a prank？ You set this whole thing up just to get me to go to class！？」

name: Iori
message: 「N-No, it's not！ Well, I mean, it kinda is, but...！」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Haaaah, what the heck, seriously！」

name: Ririmu
message: 「I look like an idiot for actually listening to you seriously！」
Ririmu, starting to fume in a huff.

name: Iori
message: 「Wait, Ririmu, listen...」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Yeah, no, this really isn't the mood for listening anymore」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「A-Ahahahaha... Did I, uh, totally screw up？」

name: Iori
message: 「Yeah, you completely screwed up」

name: Asahi
message: 「You certainly did」

name: Ririmu
message: 「You've really gone and done it, huh~」
That nice momentum had been completely ruined by a single remark from Setsugekka.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「...Well, that's my cue to exit.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Like hell it is！」
Ririmu grabs Setsugekka by the scruff of her neck.

name: Ririmu
message: 「Alright, spill it! What’s this about a hidden camera prank?」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「W-wait, Ririmu-chan, I’m just a side guest here!」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「I'm basically in that position of a young comedian who jumped at the chance when they were told they'd get some screen time!」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「The masterminds are those two over there, Muragaki-sensei and Asahi-chan!」
Hearing Setsugekka's words, Ririmu turns her gaze toward me and Asahi.

name: Ririmu
message: 「...I see. I think I get it now.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「So that whole thing where you stopped in front of the convenience store to talk? That was staged for my benefit, wasn't it?」
She's right. I had said those things on purpose just to make sure Ririmu heard them.

name: Ririmu
message: 「Ugh... what a letdown.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「I thought Sensei was actually thinking about me seriously, but I got played like a damn fiddle.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「That demoness included, you guys are all my enemies, huh.」

name: Asahi
message: 「Heh, what a coincidence. I think of you as my enemy too.」

name: Iori
message: 「Asahi, don't make things any more complicated...」
Just as I started to say that, Asahi held up a palm toward me, signaling me to stop.

name: Asahi
message: 「However, I would like you to retract your assessment of Iori-sensei.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Huh？ And why should I listen to you？」

name: Asahi
message: 「Let's be honest.」

name: Asahi
message: 「If you fail your written exam and get expelled, I truly couldn't care less.」

name: Asahi
message: 「If you don't have the motivation, you should just leave the academy. That's all there is to it.」

name: Asahi
message: 「May Ririmu-san remain oblivious to how wonderful Iori-sensei is, cling stubbornly to her own values, and fade into obscurity.」

name: Asahi
message: 「What I said back then was, without a doubt, my true feelings.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Wow, you really do have the most charming personality, don't you...！」

name: Asahi
message: 「Thank you for the compliment.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「I wasn't complimenting you!」

name: Asahi
message: 「To begin with, I never wanted you to receive instruction from Iori-sensei.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「So? Then that's the end of the discussion, right?」

name: Asahi
message: 「Then for whom, and to what end, was this little charade staged?」

name: Asahi
message: 「You understand, don't you？ This was something Iori-sensei did for your sake.」

name: Asahi
message: 「You may despise me all you want.」

name: Asahi
message: 「Because I don't care for you either.」

name: Asahi
message: 「But Iori-sensei is different.」

name: Asahi
message: 「The words he spoke to you at that time,」

name: Asahi
message: 「'I don't want you to quit. You have a rare talent.'」

name: Asahi
message: 「'I want to see you grow as a swordswoman.'」

name: Asahi
message: 「'If you were to disappear, I would be sad, and it would be incredibly frustrating.'」

name: Asahi
message: 「These were by no means an act or a performance.」

name: Asahi
message: 「He wants you to attend class, he wants you to become stronger.」

name: Asahi
message: 「He simply cannot bring himself to abandon you.」

name: Asahi
message: 「Because he feels that way, he did this while agonizing over how he might be able to get you to accept him.」

name: Asahi
message: 「I, who have revered Iori-sensei since I was small, can guarantee this.」

name: Asahi
message: 「Iori-sensei wants to be your ally from the bottom of his heart.」

name: Asahi
message: 「Please, I beg you, do not doubt that, at the very least.」
Ririmu falls silent at Asahi's words.
I, too, found myself unable to say a word.
And then, time that I couldn't tell if it was long or short passed by—

name: Ririmu
message: 「Aaaaaaaaaaah, seriously！ Fine, I get it！」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Iorin！」

name: Iori
message: 「Yes！」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Don't you ever try to trick me again, got it！？」

name: Iori
message: 「U-Understood.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Sigh... Not that I can count on a Kijo's guarantee one bit, though.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Even I can tell you're not a bad guy, Sensei.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「So I take back calling you an enemy. Sorry, Sensei.」

name: Iori
message: 「No, I'm the one in the wrong here. I'm sorry.」

name: Iori
message: 「I should've just come at you head-on instead of pulling cheap tricks.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Anyway, why'd you even think of putting on an act in the first place？」

name: Iori
message: 「Well, you know, you treat Asahi like an enemy, right, Ririmu？」

name: Ririmu
message: 「It's not just treating her like an enemy—she is one.」

name: Asahi
message: 「Ufufufufu.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「You're scaring me, Asahi-chan, say something...」

name: Iori
message: 「Well, so I figured if you found out I was teaching Asahi how to counter you, you'd want to get coached too.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Ah, yeah, that definitely made me want to.」

name: Iori
message: 「And I figured if we showed you everyone getting along—Setsugekka included—you'd want to join the circle too.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Hmm, that worked on me too~」

name: Ririmu
message: 「I want to have a good time at the academy too, after all.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Hate to admit it, but without that little act, I probably wouldn't have gone out of my way to talk to you myself, Iorin~」

name: Asahi
message: 「In other words, Operation 'Green Grass Belongs to Everyone,' devised by Sensei, hit the mark brilliantly—the conquest operation paid off.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「I wonder about that.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Operation Green Grass Belongs to Everyone？」

name: Iori
message: 「Sharing everything as a team—both the good and the bad—and encouraging each other as we push one another to improve.」

name: Iori
message: 「That's the best way to grow strong at Murakumo Academy.」

name: Iori
message: 「That's why, instead of getting jealous that 'the grass is greener on the other side,' I named it with the meaning that we should all go to that greener grass together！」
If I do say so myself, I think it's a pretty well-crafted operation name.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Whoa, that's where it came from？ Isn't that kind of lame？」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Yeah, lame. Pretentious and snobby-sounding.」

name: Asahi
message: 「Your lack of naming sense is part of your charm too, Iori-sensei.」

name: Iori
message: 「Guh...! Y-You guys...!」
They really tore into me.

name: Ririmu
message: 「More importantly, seriously, give me a break with telling Kijo my weaknesses.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「There's no way I ever want to lose to her.」

name: Iori
message: 「Fine by me, but don't you want to know Asahi's weaknesses, Ririmu？」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Oh, I definitely want to know those!」

name: Iori
message: 「Then I'll tell each of you the other's weaknesses. That keeps things fair.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Ehhh?! No way, no way, I want to be the only one who gets stronger!」

name: Iori
message: 「No can do. I've made up my mind not to play favorites like that.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Whaaat, you stingy jerk！」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Hey, hey, Ririmu-chan.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Hm？ What？」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「So in the end, did you decide to come to class, Ririmu-chan？」
At that question, she awkwardly averts her eyes.

name: Ririmu
message: 「Uh... Well, I mean, that's the plan for now.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Ooh, going dere.」

name: Asahi
message: 「That's wonderful, Iori-sensei.」

name: Iori
message: 「Yeah！」

name: Ririmu
message: 「H-Hey, I'm not going dere！ I'm only doing it 'cause I have to！」

name: Ririmu
message: 「If Sensei doesn't keep his promise properly, I'll stop going again, you hear me！」

name: Iori
message: 「Come on, don't say that. You're gonna hurt my feelings.」

name: Asahi
message: 「May Ririmu-san remain oblivious to how wonderful Iori-sensei is, cling stubbornly to her own values, and fade into obscurity.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「I told you to cut that out！」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Besides, I already noticed Sensei's good points ages ago! Your prayers didn't work even a single millimeter~」

name: Asahi
message: 「It seems Ririmu-san has realized how wonderful Iori-sensei is.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Whoa, Ririmu-chan went all dere again~」

name: Ririmu
message: 「N-No, I'm telling you that's not it~~~！！！」
And so, with one thing and another.
There were a few hiccups along the way, but the Ririmu conquest was safely completed.
Con-
quest
Complete
